d: In this video, Firstpost looks at the war of words between Elon Musk and Binance co-founder Changpeng Zhao, also known as CZ, after a massive cryptocurrency heist. Musk appeared to mock Binance's security breach on social media, prompting CZ to hit back and ask him to stop trolling. The exchange comes as Binance deals with losses estimated at $6.3 billion, in what analytics firms describe as the largest crypto heist on record. Investigators suspect North Korean-linked hackers were behind the attack. Binance says it will cover the losses and that its investigation is ongoing.
